_comment: Rev 2 starter detection rules for the distributed scraping / bot traffic from attack #12. Four complementary rules: (A) aggressive single IP with auto-block, (B) distributed same-ASN cluster grouped into one signal per ASN, (C) no-conversion behavioral scraper, (D) anonymized-infrastructure source via threat intelligence. Adapt in Security > App and API Protection > Detection Rules, or POST to /api/v2/security_monitoring/rules. Tune thresholds/windows to your environment. Replace service:appsec-threat-emulation with your service.

rules.name: Scraping - aggressive single source (Rule A)
rules.message: High-volume scraping from a single IP against {{service}}. Source {{@http.client_ip}} (AS{{@network.client.asn}} / {{@network.client.asn_org}}).
rules.response: On high/critical, Block IP (@http.client_ip) for a fixed duration via In-App WAF.

rules.name: Scraping - distributed same-ASN cluster (Rule B)
rules.message: Distributed scraping from {{@network.client.asn_org}} (AS{{@network.client.asn}}) against {{service}}: many distinct IPs from one network.
rules.signalGrouping: Generate one signal per @network.client.asn so member IPs roll into a single signal.
rules.response: Block the member @http.client_ip values. AAP blocks by IP, not ASN. Consider notify-first to avoid blocking a shared cloud network.

rules.name: Scraping - reads catalog, never converts (Rule C)
rules.message: No-conversion scraping against {{service}}: source viewed many catalog pages with no purchase intent. Source {{@http.client_ip}}.
rules.note: Catches slow, well-behaved scrapers that stay under rate limits. The bot.signal.no_conversion tag is precomputed by the target instrumentation (many catalog views, zero basket/order requests).

rules.name: Scraping - anonymized infrastructure source (Rule D)
rules.message: Scraping from anonymized infrastructure against {{service}}: source rides residential-proxy / Tor / scanner networks. Source {{@http.client_ip}}.

queries.name: anon_infra
queries.query: service:appsec-threat-emulation (@threat_intel.results.category:(residential_proxy OR tor OR corp_vpn OR scanner) OR @bot.signal.anon_proxy:true)

rules.note: In production, @threat_intel.results.category is supplied automatically by Datadog Threat Intelligence. @bot.signal.anon_proxy is the lab stand-in emitted by the demo instrumentation. This rule catches proxy-based scrapers that the datacenter-IP signal (Rule A/B) misses.
